# Ambrose Kerr

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly fifty years old  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P30](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0030), [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls area (across the harbor)  <sub>[v4 c6 P32](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0032), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c37 P14](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0014)</sub>

## Appearance

For fifteen years, Ambrose maintained a very unusual look with long, untrimmed hair and a lengthy beard, making him resemble a cheap side-show oddity or an ancient Viking. After trimming his hair and shaving off his beard following the Liberal victory, he appeared so drastically altered that even long-time acquaintances failed to recognize him at first glance. He possesses an exceptionally powerful physique, described as having the strength of an ox.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P27](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0027), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032)_

## Personality

Ambrose is a clever, sharp, and widely read individual who enjoys sharing entertaining tales and singing old Scotch ballads. He possesses an exceptionally resolute, persistent nature—holding a single strain of stubborn silliness—and will strictly adhere to an oath or promise once made. He exhibits a quick temper and enjoys a good-humored jest, often relishing situations where others fail to recognize him. Additionally, he was renowned in his youth as a famous dancer and maintains a lively, rhythmic style on his feet.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c37 P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), [v4 c37 P18](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0018)_

## Goals

- See the Liberal (Grit) party achieve political power  <sub>[v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034)</sub>

## History

During a exceptionally intense general election fifteen years prior, Ambrose Kerr campaigned passionately for the Liberal (Grit) party and publicly swore he would refrain from shaving his face or cutting his hair until his party returned to power. Following their defeat, he steadfastly kept his vow for fifteen years, growing out a long beard and hair. He frequently spent time cod-fishing with his old friend Captain Saul, and during a New Year's Eve gathering at Captain Saul's house, he entertained the guests by singing Scotch ballads and dancing vigorously with Lorna Ainslie. Upon learning around midnight after election day that the Liberals had finally won, Ambrose proceeded immediately to Augustus Palmer's barber shop in the Glen, forced the reluctant Tory barber to open his shop, and had his hair trimmed and beard shaved before sunrise. He later visited Captain Saul while clean-shaven, enjoying the fact that Nell Harcourt initially failed to recognize him. Shortly thereafter, he became engaged to Miss Winifred Tolley, agreeing to move into her green house upon their marriage.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P27](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0027), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c35 P31](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0031), [v4 c35 P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032), [v4 c37 P8](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0008), [v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009), [v4 c37 P14](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0014), [v4 c40 P11](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0011)_
